t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Green yellow orange and blue gnomes take you to one forest. Other colors take you to another forest. Go to the green/yellow/orange/blue forest for more mushrooms, until the numbers decrease to 1/2/3, then go to the other forest. Numbers will replenish whilst you are in the opposite forest.

vb_textbox.text: There are two different forests that you may be directed to. Mushrooms seem to be allocated randomly.
